reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Replication-gated waveform/RPE-selected units, five-probability middle-delay model and conditional later magnitude matching.

checks.reason: No explicit commitment to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated technical protocol for pre-execution settings and transfer is made; local calibration and preregistration alone do not meet M.

Core preparation/recording, delivery magnitude and behavioral acquisition settings lack a complete executable quantitative workflow or concrete calibration-to-setting procedure; listing parameters to freeze later is insufficient.
Timing, delivery, identity and stability checks lack numerical acceptance-to-action thresholds or a concrete derivation of tolerances before the main contrast.
Animal-level pilot variance and meaningful effect planning are present, but no numerical power or confidence-width target is specified for the confirmatory sample.
The hierarchical conceptual model does not specify a likelihood/dispersion decision with diagnostics and a concrete multiplicity procedure across the several primary comparisons.
Repair/redesigned pilot suggestions do not explicitly require a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmatory data after parameter changes.
No complete raw-trial/unit manifest with exact analysis/acquisition versions/settings, calibration records and all technical/biological losses is specified.

checks.quote: a phasic response to unpredicted reward
checks.reason: Neuron identity and analytic progression require the expected reward-prediction-response profile in the same cells, rather than an independently qualified dopamine population. The preparation is response-selected even though delay modulation is not itself the gate.

checks.quote: Fewer levels leave M2 and M3 collinear
checks.reason: Three suitable probabilities, such as 0,.5,1, already identify distinct linear and quadratic probability components. Five points improve shape estimation but are not mathematically required to avoid collinearity.

checks.quote: If only the late window is modulated, report M4, not uncertainty
checks.reason: A late delay ramp can carry uncertainty; its timing alone cannot identify temporal hazard. Likewise disappearance after movement matching does not prove the confound model. These categorical decisions overidentify mechanisms.
Decoder cross-validation has no independent animal/session split, and no separate confirmation cohort is committed. Within-animal label shuffling is a null test, not independent replication.
